title: Concept: Locked environment records no interpreter version
description: Gemfile.lock declares a Gemfile.lock with no `RUBY VERSION` section, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a Gemfile.lock with no `RUBY VERSION` section.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Gemfile.lock (rubygems).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a Gemfile.lock with no `RUBY VERSION` section.
